dialogues.en: I glance at my bag full of books and walk to the door.
dialogues.text: I glance at my bag full of books and walk to the door.

dialogues.jp:
玄関の扉の所に、誰か居る。その向こうには、
応対している頼子さんの姿が。
dialogues.en: "I'm home!"
dialogues.text: "I'm home!"

dialogues.jp: （また、例によって新聞の勧誘か？）
（やれやれ。熱心な事で）

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ah... Hi, Junichi......"
dialogues.text: "Ah... Hi, Junichi......"

dialogues.jp:
くしゃっとそれを握りつぶす。そして、逃げる
ように足音が遠ざかっていった。
dialogues.en:
She crushes something in her hand. As if she's running away
from me, she runs back inside the house.
dialogues.text:
She crushes something in her hand. As if she's running away
from me, she runs back inside the house.

dialogues.jp: 遅いんだよな……。
dialogues.en: I saw it......
dialogues.text: I saw it......

dialogues.jp:
写真にでも写したように、俺の目にはばっちり
と焼き付いてしまっている。
dialogues.en: It burned into my eyes clearly like a picture.
dialogues.text: It burned into my eyes clearly like a picture.

dialogues.jp:
ったく！　いったいそれは、どこまで俺にまと
わりつくんだろう。
dialogues.en: God! How many times do I have to see it!
dialogues.text: God! How many times do I have to see it!

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんが手に持ち、深刻な顔でそれに目を落
としていたのは、あの、猫を探すチラシだった。
dialogues.en:
The flyer that Yoriko-san was holding in her hand and
reading seriously was the flyer 'looking for a cat'.
dialogues.text:
The flyer that Yoriko-san was holding in her hand and
reading seriously was the flyer 'looking for a cat'.

dialogues.jp: 「頼子さん」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの脇に立ち、こちらに背中を向けてい
る頼子さんに呼びかける。
dialogues.en:
She's standing next to the table with her back toward me
when I talk to her.
dialogues.text:
She's standing next to the table with her back toward me
when I talk to her.

dialogues.jp:
両肩に手を回して、まるで寒さを｛こら／堪｝えているみ
たいな姿だった。
dialogues.en: She's holding her shoulders as if she's cold.
dialogues.text: She's holding her shoulders as if she's cold.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……その……何か？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, umm...... What is it?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, umm...... What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
床の辺りに視線を｛は／這｝わせ、決して俺の顔を見よ
うとはしない。
dialogues.en: She looks down at the floor and never tries to look at me.
dialogues.text: She looks down at the floor and never tries to look at me.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、また料理の本を買ってきたからさ。ほ
　ら、これ」
dialogues.en: "I bought you more cookery books. See?"
dialogues.text: "I bought you more cookery books. See?"

dialogues.jp: 本屋の包みを示し、テーブルの上に置く。
dialogues.en: I show her the bag and put it on the table.
dialogues.text: I show her the bag and put it on the table.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、暇つぶしにでも」
dialogues.en: "Whenever you are bored..."
dialogues.text: "Whenever you are bored..."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... Thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... Thank you so much."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや」
dialogues.en: "You're welcome."
dialogues.text: "You're welcome."

dialogues.jp:
言いたい事があるはずなのに。こんな、本がど
うしたとかではなくて。けれど肝心の言葉が出
てこない。
dialogues.en:
I want to talk to her about something. And it's not about
cooking books. But I don't know how to begin.
dialogues.text:
I want to talk to her about something. And it's not about
cooking books. But I don't know how to begin.

dialogues.jp:
まるで、爆弾でも抱えている気分だった。放り
投げたいけれど、それが問題の解決にならない。
dialogues.en:
I feel like I'm holding a bomb. I want to throw it away but
I know it won't solve the problem.
dialogues.text:
I feel like I'm holding a bomb. I want to throw it away but
I know it won't solve the problem.

dialogues.jp: もろとも、吹っ飛ぶかもしれないのだ。
dialogues.en: We'll probably be blown up together.
dialogues.text: We'll probably be blown up together.

dialogues.jp:
爆発そのものを避けるには、どうしたらいいの
だろうか……？
dialogues.en: How can I get rid of the bomb?
dialogues.text: How can I get rid of the bomb?

dialogues.jp: テーブルに目を向けたまま、頼子さんが言った。
dialogues.en: She begins to speak, looking at the table.
dialogues.text: She begins to speak, looking at the table.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「今夜もその……カレーにしようと思うのですが
　……」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking we could have curry again for dinner
tonight......"
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking we could have curry again for dinner
tonight......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん、俺は構わないけど」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yeah. I'm fine with that."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yeah. I'm fine with that."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「もう、温めますか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to warm it up now?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to warm it up now?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん、そうだね。じゃあ、着替えてくるわ」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I'll go change my clothes."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I'll go change my clothes."

dialogues.jp:
居間を出る時、背中に視線を感じた。一度も俺
の顔には向けられなかったのに。
dialogues.en:
When I leave the living room, I feel her stare on my back
despite the fact she didn't even look at me when I was
facing her.
dialogues.text:
When I leave the living room, I feel her stare on my back
despite the fact she didn't even look at me when I was
facing her.

dialogues.jp: ──振り返りたい衝動を抑えられない。
dialogues.en: I can't stop myself from turning around.
dialogues.text: I can't stop myself from turning around.

dialogues.jp: もう、居なかった。
dialogues.en: She isn't there anymore.
dialogues.text: She isn't there anymore.

dialogues.jp: 「気のせいだったりして」
dialogues.en: "It might just be my imagination."
dialogues.text: "It might just be my imagination."

dialogues.jp: 「あぐぅ……」
dialogues.en: "Slurp..."
dialogues.text: "Slurp..."

dialogues.jp: 「いぐぅ……」
dialogues.en: "Nyorm..."
dialogues.text: "Nyorm..."

dialogues.jp: 「えぐぅ……」
dialogues.en: "Munch..."
dialogues.text: "Munch..."

dialogues.jp:
いい加減天井との、にらめっこは飽き飽きなの
だが、いかんせん腹が膨れすぎている。今なら
カレーの匂いを嗅ぐだけで、決壊しそうだ。
dialogues.en:
I've had too much curry and I'm so full. Now I can totally
lose myself by just smelling it.
dialogues.text:
I've had too much curry and I'm so full. Now I can totally
lose myself by just smelling it.

dialogues.jp: （さすがに、無理をしすぎたか……）
dialogues.en: (I did eat too much......)
dialogues.text: (I did eat too much......)

dialogues.jp: そろそろ、鍋を綺麗にしたいと思ったのだ。
dialogues.en: I wanted to finish all of it to clean the pot.
dialogues.text: I wanted to finish all of it to clean the pot.

dialogues.jp:
そんな訳で、さっきから２時間程も、ベッドに
張りつくことになってしまった。
dialogues.en: So I ended up lying down on my bed for 2 hours.
dialogues.text: So I ended up lying down on my bed for 2 hours.

dialogues.jp:
重たいため息をつく。腹の重たさが、それに輪
を掛けている感じ。
dialogues.en:
I give a heavy sigh. And it makes me feel heavier in my
stomach.
dialogues.text:
I give a heavy sigh. And it makes me feel heavier in my
stomach.

dialogues.jp:
夕飯の時の寂しさが思い出される。ほとんど何
も、会話がなかったのだ。
dialogues.en: I think about dinnertime. We barely talked.
dialogues.text: I think about dinnertime. We barely talked.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに沈黙が寂しくて、テレビなんかをつけ
てみたりしたものの、ますます寂しさは、募る
ばかりだった。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't stand it and turned on the TV, but it only
increased the loneliness.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't stand it and turned on the TV, but it only
increased the loneliness.

dialogues.jp:
「結局、何者なんだろうな、頼子さんって……。
　きちんと、｛き／訊｝いた方がいいのかな？」
dialogues.en:
"After all, who is she......? Maybe I should just ask her
and get things straight."
dialogues.text:
"After all, who is she......? Maybe I should just ask her
and get things straight."

dialogues.jp:
本当に、元は猫だった？　メルヒェンがきつす
ぎて、にわかには信じがたいのだけど……。
dialogues.en:
Did she really use to be a cat? It's too hard to believe,
but......
dialogues.text:
Did she really use to be a cat? It's too hard to believe,
but......

dialogues.jp:
（けど俺自身、メルヒェンの世界に片足どころ
　か両足突っ込んでるしな……）
dialogues.en:
(But I, myself, have a power that's also hard to
believe...... )
dialogues.text:
(But I, myself, have a power that's also hard to
believe...... )

dialogues.jp:
それに、あのチラシを目にしていた時の、頼子
さんの様子。あれは、ただ事じゃなかった。
dialogues.en:
And the expression she had when she read the flyer wasn't
normal.
dialogues.text:
And the expression she had when she read the flyer wasn't
normal.

dialogues.jp:
いくつもの事象が、ひとつの事実にスポットラ
イトを浴びせかけているように思える。
dialogues.en:
It seems like many incidents are pointing spotlights at one
fact.
dialogues.text:
It seems like many incidents are pointing spotlights at one
fact.

dialogues.jp: つまり──。
dialogues.en: That is...
dialogues.text: That is...

dialogues.jp: こんこん。
dialogues.en: Knock, knock.
dialogues.text: Knock, knock.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes, come in."
dialogues.text: "Yes, come in."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「し、失礼します……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
ニトログリセリンを腹に内蔵している気分で、
そろそろと上体を起こす。
dialogues.en: I slowly wake up as if I just took a nitroglycerin pill.
dialogues.text: I slowly wake up as if I just took a nitroglycerin pill.

dialogues.jp: その尋常じゃない様子に、すぐに気がつく。
dialogues.en: I notice right away something's wrong with her.
dialogues.text: I notice right away something's wrong with her.

dialogues.jp:
両手はぶるぶると震え、顔は紙のように真っ白。
口元は固く引き締められている。
dialogues.en:
Both of her hands are shaking and her face is as white as
paper. Her mouth is tightly closed.
dialogues.text:
Both of her hands are shaking and her face is as white as
paper. Her mouth is tightly closed.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "Wh-What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Wh-What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
すっくと立ち上がる。腹がどうのなんて、言っ
ていられない雰囲気。
dialogues.en: I stand up. I don't care about my stomach now.
dialogues.text: I stand up. I don't care about my stomach now.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「は、話……話が……あるんです……」
dialogues.en: "I...... need to talk to you......"
dialogues.text: "I...... need to talk to you......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん、分かったから。まあ、落ち着いて」
dialogues.en: "O-Okay. We'll talk, so please calm down."
dialogues.text: "O-Okay. We'll talk, so please calm down."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、編んだ髪が振りほどけそうな程に首を
振った。少し荒くなった息で、顔を伏せる。
dialogues.en:
But she shakes her head from side to side so hard that her
tied-up hair is about to fall down. She's breathing hard and
looking down.
dialogues.text:
But she shakes her head from side to side so hard that her
tied-up hair is about to fall down. She's breathing hard and
looking down.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さん……私……私……！」
dialogues.en: "Junichi-san, I......I......!"
dialogues.text: "Junichi-san, I......I......!"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「頼子さん……」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san......"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私……私……お、お願いが……」
dialogues.en: "I...... I...... have a favor to ask you......"
dialogues.text: "I...... I...... have a favor to ask you......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お願いが……あって……」
dialogues.en: "Could you...... do me a favor?"
dialogues.text: "Could you...... do me a favor?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん、うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes, yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes, yes."

dialogues.jp:
思わず、子どもをあやすみたいな声を出してし
まう。それが何であれ、叶えてあげなければな
らない、そんな風に感じた。
dialogues.en:
I answer softly as if I was answering a crying child to calm
them down. I think, no matter what she wants me to do, I
have to do it for her.
dialogues.text:
I answer softly as if I was answering a crying child to calm
them down. I think, no matter what she wants me to do, I
have to do it for her.

dialogues.jp:
そっと歩み寄り、両肩に手を置く。ぴくりと、
身体が震えた。
dialogues.en:
I slowly walk towards her and gently put my hands on her
shoulders. Her body's shaking slightly.
dialogues.text:
I slowly walk towards her and gently put my hands on her
shoulders. Her body's shaking slightly.

dialogues.jp: そっと、顔を上げる。
dialogues.en: She slowly brings her head up.
dialogues.text: She slowly brings her head up.

dialogues.jp:
初めて出会った日と同じように、頬に、涙の跡
が走っていた。
dialogues.en:
Just like the first day we met, she has traces of tears on
her cheeks.
dialogues.text:
Just like the first day we met, she has traces of tears on
her cheeks.

dialogues.jp: 「お願いって？」
dialogues.en: "What do you want me to do?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want me to do?"

dialogues.jp:
再び｛うつむ／俯｝いてしまう。長い｛まつげ／睫毛｝が、ぱちぱちとし
ばたたいた。
dialogues.en:
She lowers her head again. Her long eyelashes are blinking
fast.
dialogues.text:
She lowers her head again. Her long eyelashes are blinking
fast.

dialogues.jp: こくんと、唾を飲み込む音が聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: She's holding her breath.
dialogues.text: She's holding her breath.

dialogues.jp: 胸元に言い募るようにして、彼女は言った。
dialogues.en: She finally opens her mouth and says,
dialogues.text: She finally opens her mouth and says,

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私……ここに、居ても……いいですよね？」
dialogues.en: "Could you...... let me...... stay here...?"
dialogues.text: "Could you...... let me...... stay here...?"

dialogues.jp:
頷きながら答える──が、俺の声の方が出るよ
りも一瞬早く、彼女は続きを繋げた。
dialogues.en:
As I'm about to nod yes and answer, she continues her
sentence,
dialogues.text:
As I'm about to nod yes and answer, she continues her
sentence,

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「──メイドとして」
dialogues.en: "......as a maid."
dialogues.text: "......as a maid."

dialogues.jp:
笑みにほころんだ顔で、俺を見上げる。対する
俺は、多分不器用な笑顔を張り付けているはず。
dialogues.en:
She looks up at me with a big smile. On the other hand, I
probably have a weird smile on my face.
dialogues.text:
She looks up at me with a big smile. On the other hand, I
probably have a weird smile on my face.

dialogues.jp:
応答にズレが生じていた。承諾はメイドという
単語が出てくる前に為されたものだ。
dialogues.en:
There was a time difference between the end of her question
and my answer to it. My approval of her staying here was
made before she said 'as a maid'.
dialogues.text:
There was a time difference between the end of her question
and my answer to it. My approval of her staying here was
made before she said 'as a maid'.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、その単語が、その承諾を｛くつがえ／覆｝してしま
うという訳でもないのだが……。
dialogues.en: Of course, it won't change my approval either, but......
dialogues.text: Of course, it won't change my approval either, but......

dialogues.jp:
そもそも俺は、どうしてそんな事にこだわるの
だろう？
dialogues.en: ...But why do I care about that so much?
dialogues.text: ...But why do I care about that so much?

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ありがとうございます……」
dialogues.en: "Th-Thank you so much......"
dialogues.text: "Th-Thank you so much......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私……私……嬉しいです……」

本当に、嬉しげに微笑む頼子さん。涙で荒れた
頬が、不思議とマッチしている。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko-san's smiling happily. Her cheeks rough with tears
somehow perfect match her smile.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko-san's smiling happily. Her cheeks rough with tears
somehow perfect match her smile.

dialogues.jp:
どこかへ身体を流されてしまうような、妙な不
安感を感じて、肩に置いた手に力を込めた。
dialogues.en:
I feel a weird anxiety like I could be about to drift off
somewhere, so I tighten my grip on her shoulders.
dialogues.text:
I feel a weird anxiety like I could be about to drift off
somewhere, so I tighten my grip on her shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんを励ましているようで、その実、自分
自身を｛こぶ／鼓舞｝している。
dialogues.en:
I pretend the grip's to encourage her, but the truth is it's
for me to convince myself.
dialogues.text:
I pretend the grip's to encourage her, but the truth is it's
for me to convince myself.

dialogues.jp: 「何言ってんだって、当たり前じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about? Of course you can stay here."
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about? Of course you can stay here."

dialogues.jp:
そんな自分の声を、どこか遠くからのように聞
いている俺が居た──。
dialogues.en: I'm listening to myself saying it from somewhere far away.
dialogues.text: I'm listening to myself saying it from somewhere far away.

dialogues.jp:
そして、さっきまでのように、俺は天井を見つ
めていた。
dialogues.en:
And again I stare at the ceiling just like I was doing
before.
dialogues.text:
And again I stare at the ceiling just like I was doing
before.

dialogues.jp: 「メイドとして……か」
dialogues.en: "As a maid...... huh?"
dialogues.text: "As a maid...... huh?"

dialogues.jp:
考えてみれば、出会った当初から、今の今まで、
頼子さんは朝倉家のメイドなのだ。
dialogues.en:
As I think about it, she's been a maid of this house since
the first day we met till today at this moment.
dialogues.text:
As I think about it, she's been a maid of this house since
the first day we met till today at this moment.

dialogues.jp:
彼女の正体をひとまずとすれば、俺にとっては、
それ以外の何者でもない。
dialogues.en: Putting aside who she really is, she is just a maid to me.
dialogues.text: Putting aside who she really is, she is just a maid to me.

dialogues.jp:
メイドとして家にやって来て、メイドとして居
続ける事を確認した。
dialogues.en:
I just confirmed that she came to this house as a maid and
she is going to stay here as a maid.
dialogues.text:
I just confirmed that she came to this house as a maid and
she is going to stay here as a maid.

dialogues.jp: 「でも……いいのか、それ？」
dialogues.en: "But...... is it really okay?"
dialogues.text: "But...... is it really okay?"

dialogues.jp: 答えはどこにも見つからない──俺にとっては。
dialogues.en: I can't find the answer anywhere...
dialogues.text: I can't find the answer anywhere...

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、そもそもの初めから、それを望ん
でいる。けれど、俺は？
dialogues.en:
That's what she wanted from the beginning. But what about
me?
dialogues.text:
That's what she wanted from the beginning. But what about
me?

dialogues.jp:
疑問が降り積もっていく。雪のように埋もれて
しまい、それが重たすぎて……、
dialogues.en:
Many questions pile up on me like heavy snow, and it's so
heavy......
dialogues.text:
Many questions pile up on me like heavy snow, and it's so
heavy......

dialogues.jp: 俺は、目を閉じた。
dialogues.en: I close my eyes.
dialogues.text: I close my eyes.

dialogues.jp: ◆メイドとしてこの家に◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんに素性をはっきり聞くべきなんだろう
か？
dialogues.en:
There's someone at the front door of my house, and
Yoriko-san's talking to that person.
dialogues.text:
There's someone at the front door of my house, and
Yoriko-san's talking to that person.

dialogues.jp:
確かに例のチラシを手にした頼子さんの様子は
ただ事ではなかった。
dialogues.en: (Is it the newspaper salesman again?)
dialogues.text: (Is it the newspaper salesman again?)

dialogues.jp:
ひとり悩む俺に、頼子さんは「メイドとしてこ
こに居てもいいですか？」と尋ねるのだった。
dialogues.en:
I walk closer, planning to shoo him off. But it looks like
they've just finished the conversation and Yoriko-san closes
the door.
dialogues.text:
I walk closer, planning to shoo him off. But it looks like
they've just finished the conversation and Yoriko-san closes
the door.

dialogues.jp:
メイドとして、頼子さんはそれを望んでいる。
でも俺は……。
dialogues.en:
The person --the man-- walks out of the gate and goes to the
next house.
dialogues.text:
The person --the man-- walks out of the gate and goes to the
next house.

dialogues.jp: 答えは見つからなかった。
dialogues.en: (He is a hard worker.)
dialogues.text: (He is a hard worker.)
